_: Which stop gets a photograph, and what the photograph is of.
Keyed by trip id, then by activity id — the same ids the itinerary uses.
A stop missing from this file gets no photo, and that is the normal case
for buses, flights and 'dinner back at the base': a stock picture of an
airport tells the reader nothing the words did not. Photograph the thing
you would not recognise from its name.
A place appears once per trip. When the week returns to it — the same beach
on day 1 and day 7 — only the first visit carries the picture, so the page
does not repeat itself on the way down.
The value says where to look:
'Palma Cathedral'        the article of that name, English first, then
es / ca / it / de, then Commons — but only if
the article it lands on is still recognisably
the thing asked for
'ca:Banys Àrabs de Palma'  that exact article on that wiki
'commons:Platja d'en Repic'  search Commons files, skip articles
'file:Drach Caves.jpg'     that exact photograph, no searching at all
Most of the pins below are here because the unpinned search got it wrong:
English Wikipedia has no article for half of Mallorca, and Commons will
happily answer 'Santa Catalina, Palma' with a castle in the Canaries.
Regenerate photos.js with:  node tools/photos.mjs
